headline: Government switches to strict austerity: what will happen to pensions and salaries
summary: Ukraine's Cabinet is introducing a strict austerity regime for budget spending because of rapidly growing army needs. It also plans a detailed audit of Ministry of Defense spending.
why: Budget austerity and defence spending decisions affect public finances, government debt financing, and the economic outlook for Ukraine.
